description: Re-encode a video with a compression mode (no credit cost). The video is processed again from its original file (backup): without the backup the API refuses. Its current qualities are replaced by the re-encoded ones and it stays in processing until done. Encryption (HLS) is kept. To encrypt videos use panda_encrypt_videos.

compression_mode.description: size = 'Econômica' (smaller files), balanced = 'Equilibrada', quality = 'Maior qualidade' (dashboard names)

name: panda_reencode_video
title: Reencode Video
